common.notAvailableYet: Not available in this build yet.
common.previewBanner: Preview only — no real data yet.

language.title: Choose your language
language.subtitle: You can change it any time in Profile or Settings.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.workerBody: Sign in with a 6-digit code sent to your phone by text message.
signIn.staffBody: Owners, project managers, superintendents and safety managers sign in with a verified email and an authenticator app.
signIn.noPhoneBody: Ask your foreman or the site kiosk attendant. You can be checked in without a phone.
signIn.backendUnavailable: Sign-in needs a SiteMuster server. This development build has none configured.

home.title: Today
home.body: Your project status, check-in method and sync status will appear here.

projects.title: My projects
projects.body: Projects you joined through orientation, and whether each one is approved.

history.title: Time history
history.body: Your estimated onsite hours by day and week. Estimated onsite presence is not payroll.

profile.title: Profile
profile.body: Your name, employer, emergency contact, language and privacy settings.

home.title: Selected project
home.body: Estimated onsite, unknown, confirmed and visitor counts for the selected project.

projects.title: Projects
projects.body: Create and manage projects, site circles and work windows.

workforce.title: Workforce
workforce.body: Roster by company and trade, pending approvals and close-out.

map.title: Map
map.body: Site circle and recent estimated positions with time and accuracy. Stale markers are never shown as live.

more.title: More
more.body: Orientation, reports, muster, account and settings.

errors.configBody: This build is missing required configuration, so it will not run. Contact your administrator.

auth.phoneBody: We will text you a 6-digit code. Message and data rates may apply.
auth.codeSentTo: We sent a code to {{destination}}. It expires in 10 minutes.
auth.resendIn: You can request a new code in {{seconds}} s
auth.emailBody: We will email you a 6-digit code. Then you confirm with your authenticator app.
auth.noPhoneHint: No phone that receives texts? Your foreman or the site kiosk attendant can check you in.

errors.invalidPhone: Enter a valid mobile number, for example (555) 555-0123.
errors.invalidCode: That code is not correct. Check the message and try again.
errors.expiredCode: This code has expired. Request a new code.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your signal and try again. Nothing was sent.
errors.smsUnavailable: Text messages are not available right now. Ask your foreman or the kiosk attendant to check you in.
errors.mfaInvalid: That authenticator code did not work. Use the current 6-digit code.

mfa.enrollBody: Staff accounts need a second step. Scan this code with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.secretLabel: Or enter this setup key manually:
mfa.verifyBody: Open your authenticator app and enter the current 6-digit code for SiteMuster.

recovery.title: Trouble signing in
recovery.workerNewPhone: New phone, same number: just sign in again with a text-message code. Your old phone stops working for automatic attendance.
recovery.workerNewNumber: New number: ask the site superintendent or kiosk attendant to update your identity. Until then you can be checked in at the kiosk or by your foreman.
recovery.staffEmail: Lost access to your email: ask an owner of your organization to invite your new address.
recovery.staffAuthenticator: Lost your authenticator app: use your backup authenticator if you set one up. Otherwise contact SiteMuster support through your organization owner; your identity is checked before access is restored.

access.joinBody: You are signed in. To join a jobsite, scan the orientation QR shown by your superintendent or printed at the site.
access.noOrgBody: Your staff account is verified. Create your company's organization, or check whether your company has invited you.
access.operatorTitle: Operator accounts cannot use the mobile app
access.operatorBody: Platform operator accounts are limited to the private operator tools and never see worker data.
access.offlineBody: You are signed in, but SiteMuster could not confirm your access without a connection. Connect to continue. Nothing was lost.
access.staleNotice: Offline — showing your last known access.

apiErrors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this. Ask your organization owner or admin.
apiErrors.NETWORK: Couldn't reach SiteMuster. Check your connection and try again.
apiErrors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
apiErrors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a minute and try again.
apiErrors.CONFIGURATION_ERROR: Address search isn't set up for this app yet. Contact support.
apiErrors.TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE: This service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
apiErrors.INVALID_REQUEST: That address couldn't be used. Try a different search.
apiErrors.PROJECT_NUMBER_TOO_LONG: The project number can be at most 64 characters.
apiErrors.INVALID_TIMEZONE: Choose a valid time zone for the site.
apiErrors.INVALID_COORDINATES: The site location isn't valid. Search for the address again.
apiErrors.RADIUS_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: The site circle must be between 150 m and 2,000 m.
apiErrors.DWELL_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: The arrival wait must be between 5 and 60 minutes.
apiErrors.ACCURACY_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: The accuracy limit must be between 20 m and 100 m.
apiErrors.INVALID_WORK_WINDOWS: The schedule couldn't be read. Check the shifts and try again.
apiErrors.TOO_MANY_WORK_WINDOWS: Too many shifts. Use at most 42 day-and-time windows.
apiErrors.WORK_WINDOW_REQUIRED: Add at least one shift, or turn on 24/7.
apiErrors.INVALID_WORK_WINDOW_WEEKDAY: Pick valid days for each shift.
apiErrors.INVALID_WORK_WINDOW_TIME: Enter times as HH:MM in 24-hour format, for example 06:00 or 18:30.
apiErrors.EMPTY_WORK_WINDOW: A shift can't start and end at the same time.
apiErrors.OVERLAPPING_WORK_WINDOWS: Two shifts overlap. Change the times so they don't.
apiErrors.PROJECT_CLOSED: This project is completed or archived, so its settings can't change.
apiErrors.REASON_REQUIRED: Enter a short reason (at least 3 characters).
apiErrors.INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION: That status change isn't allowed from the current status.
apiErrors.DELEGATION_REQUIRES_ORG_ADMIN: Only an organization owner or admin can give these extra permissions.
apiErrors.INVITATION_NOT_FOUND: This invitation wasn't found. It may be for a different email.
apiErrors.INVITATION_NOT_ACTIVE: This invitation was already used, cancelled or has expired.
apiErrors.ORIENTATION_CODE_INVALID: That is not a valid orientation code. Scan the code on the supervisor's screen again.
apiErrors.ORIENTATION_CODE_EXPIRED: That code has changed. Scan the code on the supervisor's screen again. If it keeps failing, check the phone's date and time.
apiErrors.ORIENTATION_SESSION_CLOSED: This orientation session has ended. Ask the supervisor to start a new one.
apiErrors.PROJECT_NOT_ACTIVE: This project is not active, so workers cannot join it right now.
apiErrors.NOTICE_OUTDATED: The notice was updated. Go back and read the current version.
apiErrors.NOTICE_UNAVAILABLE: The project notice is not available. Ask the supervisor.
apiErrors.CONSENT_REQUIRED: You must read and acknowledge the notice to join.
apiErrors.CONSENT_NOTICE_NOT_APPROVED: This notice is not approved yet, so joining is not possible here.
apiErrors.COMPANY_NOT_ON_PROJECT: That company is not on this project. Choose another or type the name.
apiErrors.EMERGENCY_CONTACT_REQUIRED: Enter an emergency contact name and phone number.
apiErrors.TRADE_TOO_LONG: The trade can be at most 100 characters.
apiErrors.TOO_MANY_ENROLLMENTS: Select at most 100 workers at a time.
apiErrors.INVALID_DECISION: That action is not possible for this worker's current status.
apiErrors.ENROLLMENT_NOT_APPROVED: This worker must be approved first.

scheduleErrors.SHIFT_NEEDS_DAYS: Pick at least one day for each shift.
scheduleErrors.WORK_WINDOW_REQUIRED: Add at least one shift, or turn on 24/7.
scheduleErrors.TOO_MANY_WORK_WINDOWS: Too many shifts. Use at most 42 day-and-time windows.
scheduleErrors.INVALID_WORK_WINDOW_WEEKDAY: Pick valid days for each shift.
scheduleErrors.INVALID_WORK_WINDOW_TIME: Enter times as HH:MM in 24-hour format, for example 06:00 or 18:30.
scheduleErrors.EMPTY_WORK_WINDOW: A shift can't start and end at the same time.
scheduleErrors.OVERLAPPING_WORK_WINDOWS: Two shifts overlap. Change the times so they don't.

sensitive.DWELL_REDUCED: Shorter arrival wait (arrivals are counted sooner)

projectStatusHelp.DRAFT: Draft: finish setting up the site and staff. Make the project active before workers join.
projectStatusHelp.ACTIVE: Active: the project is open for orientation and attendance.
projectStatusHelp.PAUSED: Paused: the project is on hold. Nothing is deleted, and you can make it active again.
projectStatusHelp.COMPLETED: Completed: the job is finished. Records stay available; settings can no longer change.
projectStatusHelp.ARCHIVED: Archived: hidden from daily work. Records are kept.

roleHelp.PM: Oversees the project. Can change site settings or staff only when given those permissions.
roleHelp.SUPER: Runs the site day to day and can change the site settings.
roleHelp.SAFETY: Handles safety, orientation and emergency musters.
roleHelp.ATTENDANT: Runs the check-in kiosk on a site phone or tablet.

timezone.label: Site time zone
timezone.hint: Shifts and daily reports use the site's local time, not your phone's.

schedule.operates24x7Hint: No shift hours. The arrival wait still applies.
schedule.overnightSummary: {{start}} to {{end}} the next day (overnight; counts for the day it starts)
schedule.timeFormatHint: Use 24-hour time: 06:00 is 6 AM and 18:00 is 6 PM. An end time earlier than the start time means the shift runs overnight.

site.devAddressProvider: Development address data: these are not real addresses. Real search needs the Google key from the setup checklist.
site.mapLabel: Map of the site circle, {{meters}} meters around {{address}}
site.dragHint: To adjust, press and hold the pin, then drag it to the middle of the jobsite.
site.radiusHint: Allowed: {{min}}–{{max}} m. Cover the whole work area, but avoid nearby homes, offices and other sites.
site.estimateNote: Phone attendance is an estimate, not proof that someone is on site. Arrival is counted after a phone stays inside the circle for the arrival wait; an exit is recorded only after leaving the dashed ring ({{exit}} m).
site.webPreview: Map preview (web render). Phones show the real map.

wizard.title: New project
wizard.name: Project name
wizard.orgRequired: Choose the organization for this project.
wizard.siteIntro: Find the jobsite address. The circle around it is where phones can be counted as on site.
wizard.addressRequired: Search for the site address and pick a result.
wizard.defaultsNote: Arrival wait {{minutes}} min and location accuracy limit {{accuracy}} m (standard). You can change them later.
wizard.overlapWarning: Warning: this circle overlaps or comes close to "{{name}}" ({{meters}} m between centers).
wizard.similarNameWarning: Warning: your organization already has a project named "{{name}}".
wizard.warningsAdvisory: These are warnings only. You can still create the project.
wizard.checksUnavailable: We couldn't check for nearby or similar projects right now. You can still create the project.
wizard.draftNote: The project starts as a Draft. Make it active when the site and staff are ready.
wizard.retrySafe: Trying again is safe: it will not create a second project.

projects.title: Projects
projects.emptyManager: No projects yet. Tap New project to set up your first jobsite.
projects.emptyStaff: You aren't assigned to any projects yet.

project.exitBoundary: Exit boundary: {{meters}} m from the center
project.arrivalRules: Arrival wait {{minutes}} min · accuracy limit {{accuracy}} m
project.scheduleNote: Times are the site's local time. Overnight shifts count for the day they start.
project.historyNote: Every change creates a new version. Attendance already in progress keeps the version it started with.
project.orientationNeedsActive: Make the project active to run orientation.

edit.title: Change site settings
edit.body: Saving creates a new settings version after version {{number}}. Attendance already in progress keeps the settings it started with.
edit.dwellHint: How long a phone must stay inside the circle before arrival is counted.
edit.accuracyHint: Locations less accurate than this are not used for automatic attendance.
edit.versionNote: Older versions are kept and can't be edited.
edit.sensitiveBody: These changes can make automatic attendance count more people or count them sooner. They are recorded with your name and reason.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.body: Invitations for your verified email appear here.
invitations.empty: No invitations right now. Ask the project owner or admin to invite the email you signed in with.

invite.title: Invite staff
invite.body: Invite someone to {{project}} by email. They accept by signing in to SiteMuster with that email.
invite.emergencyHint: Can see emergency contacts and lead musters for this project.
invite.delegationNote: Only an organization owner or admin can grant extra permissions.
invite.sent: Invitation created for {{email}}. No email is sent yet: ask them to install SiteMuster and sign in with this email to accept. It expires in 7 days.

org.newBody: This is your company's account in SiteMuster. You will be its owner.
org.name: Company name
org.inviteAdminBody: Admins can create projects and manage staff for the whole organization. They accept by signing in with this email.

join.scanBody: Point the camera at the code on the supervisor's phone or on the printed sheet.
join.cameraNeeded: Camera access is needed to scan. You can also type or paste the code below.
join.notOrientationCode: That is not a SiteMuster orientation code.
join.employerHint: Your employer will be confirmed by the project team.
join.emergencyHint: Only people with an emergency role on your projects can see this.
join.noticeIntro: Read this notice before you join. It explains what is recorded and your choices.
join.acknowledge: I have read and understood this notice
join.declined: You did not accept the notice, so you have not joined. Talk to your supervisor about other options.
join.doneBody: Your supervisor still has to approve you and confirm your employer. Your badge and automatic attendance are available only after approval.

notice.draftWatermark: DRAFT — this legal text is not approved yet. For testing only.
notice.notApproved: This notice has not been approved for use yet.

workerProjects.none: You have not joined a project yet.
workerProjects.offlineSaved: Offline — showing the projects saved on this phone.

badge.title: My badge
badge.activateIntro: Set up this phone once (needs a connection). After that the badge works without signal.
badge.offlineNote: Works without signal. Show it at the site kiosk.
badge.oneUse: Each code works once. Do not share screenshots.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.intro: Start a 120-minute orientation session. Workers scan the QR, read the notice and join. You approve them afterwards.
orientation.rotatingNote: The code changes every minute and works without signal on this phone.
orientation.printedNote: The printed code works only while this session is open.
orientation.shareUnavailable: Sharing is not available on this device.
orientation.neverApproves: Scanning a QR never approves anyone. You approve workers in Workers and approvals.

workers.title: Workers and approvals
workers.addNoPhone: Add a worker without a phone
workers.maxSelected: You can select up to {{max}} workers at a time.
workers.employerHint: Select approved workers to confirm their employer.

addWorker.title: Worker without a phone
addWorker.intro: Create a supervised profile. No phone number, e-mail or app account is invented. Approval is a separate step.
addWorker.noticeTitle: Read the notice to the worker
addWorker.acknowledged: I read this notice to the worker and they acknowledged it
addWorker.acknowledgedHint: Your name is recorded as the supervisor who read it.
addWorker.done: Worker added and waiting for approval.

printedBadge.title: Printed badge
printedBadge.intro: A printed badge has no personal information. At the kiosk, the attendant must check the person's name and face.
printedBadge.caption: SiteMuster badge
printedBadge.custody: Shown once. Print it now and hand it to the worker. Issuing a new badge cancels the old one.
